title: Preserve signals watermark by separating sync and full-run timestamps
answers: Why is last_synced_at not updated when a warehouse sync extracts zero rows?
How to check when an ExternalDataSchema last ran regardless of imported row count?
Why does the v3 pipeline only update last_full_run_at on quiet syncs?
body:
Zero-batch extraction runs in pipeline v3 must only stamp `last_full_run_at` and leave `last_synced_at` untouched.
Enforced at: `products/warehouse_sources/backend/temporal/data_imports/pipelines/pipeline_v3/pipeline.py:PipelineV3._stamp_full_run`.
What breaks if skipped: `last_synced_at` serves as the signals watermark (`partition_field > last_synced_at`); advancing it on empty runs skips late-arriving data in future syncs.
To inspect sync freshness or liveness, read `products/warehouse_sources/backend/models/external_data_schema.py:ExternalDataSchema.last_run_at`, which takes the maximum of both stamps.
applies: Updating sync timestamps or reading execution freshness on ExternalDataSchema.
